entries.mem0ai/mem0: This official Hermes Agent memory provider offers a universal layer for managing multi-level states across users, sessions, and agents. It supports temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval, available as an Apache-2.0 self-hosted server or managed cloud service.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: OpenViking is an official context database that organizes information as a virtual filesystem using viking:// URIs. It utilizes a three-tier loading system to achieve a 91% reduction in token consumption and provides observable retrieval trajectories for debugging.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: This platform enables persistent long-term memory by building self-hosted knowledge graphs from text and code sources. It allows for domain grounding through custom data models and ontologies that span multiple agent sessions.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: gbrain functions as an opinionated agent brain that utilizes a self-wiring knowledge graph to extract typed entity relationships. It provides synthesized answers with explicit gap analysis and supports institutional memory with scoped data access for multiple users.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: An official memory provider that features a custom vector graph engine capable of sub-300ms recall at scales exceeding 100B tokens per month. It automates fact extraction and knowledge updates while offering connectors for platforms like GitHub, Notion, and Google Drive.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: Hindsight provides a learning-based memory system centered on retain, recall, and reflect workflows. It is compatible with over 25 LLM providers and can be deployed via Docker, Kubernetes, or a managed cloud environment.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: This library serves as the foundation for stateful agents, offering session and peer management through Python and TypeScript SDKs. It uses asynchronous background reasoning to extract conclusions from conversations and supports managed or self-hosted FastAPI deployments.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: This official provider treats memory like a git repository, offering version control features such as commits, branches, and merges for a markdown context tree. It utilizes a 5-tier retrieval system to achieve sub-100ms performance and includes a React-powered TUI.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: Mnemosyne is a zero-dependency, local-only memory system that uses SQLite for data storage to avoid cloud reliance. It integrates with MCP clients and provides episodic compression alongside vector search capabilities for sub-millisecond performance.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: This seven-layer memory system for Hermes Agent utilizes a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure agents prioritize specific injected contexts. It runs on local infrastructure including Qdrant and Redis to manage structured facts and an auto-curated wiki.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: Autocontext is a recursive harness that improves agent performance by retaining lessons and artifacts through iterative task execution. It stores immutable context bundles in the filesystem and supports outcome-gated data promotion.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: This plugin provides lossless context management for Hermes Agent using a hierarchical Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) to ensure no messages are lost. It includes specialized tools like lcm_grep and lcm_recall for precise recovery of details from its SQLite store.
entries.vshulcz/deja-vu: This tool indexes existing local session history from 25 different coding agents to enable millisecond lookups over gigabytes of past data. It prioritizes security by redacting keys and tokens during the indexing process of on-disk history.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: Honcho provides a self-hosted backend for Hermes Agent that enables private cross-session memory persistence. It supports any OpenAI-compatible provider or local inference server and includes an automated setup script for Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: This local-first layer syncs memory across Hermes Agent, Claude Code, and other harnesses while maintaining high answer accuracy on LongMemEval benchmarks. It supports real-time data ingestion from external platforms including Obsidian, Discord, and GitHub.
entries.plur-ai/plur: Plur utilizes a shared memory layer that stores data as plain-text YAML files to ensure local ownership. It employs a hybrid of BM25 and embedding search for retrieval across MCP-compatible tools like Cursor and OpenClaw.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: ClawMem is an on-device context engine that operates entirely locally without cloud dependencies or API keys. It integrates via MCP and plugins, utilizing hybrid retrieval methods including vector search and BM25.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: This file-based system uses a five-tier hierarchical SQLite schema with FTS5 search instead of vector databases or embeddings. It is delivered as a five-package plugin family that includes a dedicated Hermes adapter and CLI.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: ContextPilot optimizes long-context inference by reordering and deduplicating blocks to maximize prefix reuse. This native plugin for Hermes Agent reduces prefill latency by 1.5–3× and can save up to 36% of tokens.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This self-maintaining plugin provides explainable retrieval by attaching tags to every recalled result to explain why it was selected. It features a self-directing loop to resolve knowledge gaps and supports owner-scoping for multi-user environments.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: AgentCairn uses an Obsidian vault as a source of truth, storing durable context as inspectable Markdown files with frontmatter. It functions without a daemon or external databases, relying on local embedding models and hybrid search for recall.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: Brainstack integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single memory owner for Hermes Agent. It manages state and retrieval using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to deliver purpose-built evidence packets for every agent query.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: This anticipatory memory system prefetches context by monitoring agent session logs in real-time. It is an MCP-native server that uses local-first storage via SQLite-vec and GGUF models for vector search.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: Perseus resolves live workspace state into verified facts to ensure agents load only the context they actually need. This local-first layer supports MCP-native integration and aims to reduce prompt tokens by up to 94%.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: This provider enables reflective memory through automated indexing of codebases, URLs, and multimedia with OCR support. It utilizes a combination of BM25 full-text search and ranked graph traversal, using edge tags to establish navigable, bidirectional relationships between stored notes.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: Designed to minimize prompt token overhead, this tool uses local BM25 ranking to select relevant tool schemas for Hermes Agent v0.14.0. It includes a dedicated dashboard for tracking estimated schema token savings and supports native tool search functionality.
entries.conorbronsdon/claude-context-os: This Git-backed layer manages identity, decisions, and workflows for coding agents like Claude Code and Codex using plain Markdown files. It facilitates a source-neutral migration workflow for documents and chats, serving as a persistent context and workflow repository.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin utilizes a single .lbdb embedded graph database to store memories with built-in 1-10 importance ranking. It prioritizes high-value information during context prefetch using BM25 keyword search and optional GLiNER2 entity extraction.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: A pull-model episodic memory plugin that features real, immediate event deletion and an on-demand summarizer to prevent persistent summaries from affecting future recall. It provides a transparent audit log of every memory operation via a trace.jsonl file.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server enables agents to handle financial transactions across EVM, Solana, and eight other chain families using USDC and stablecoins. It allows agents to pay for services or charge for their own API usage with 0% fees settled directly into wallets.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin functions as a routing layer that directs queries to local skills, scripts, and MCP servers. It includes tools for knowledge retrieval and neighbor traversal, while automatically generating tool routing notes through model calls.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: Providing durable cross-session memory, this plugin features a local SQLite reliability layer and a write outbox for stable state management. It supports pre-turn context injection and session-end snapshots to maintain continuity across agent interactions.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: This integration utilizes Exabase M-1 to provide self-organizing long-term memory for agents. It includes configurable query expansion and result reranking to optimize the retrieval of manually stored or searched memories.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This plugin provides private local code memory for repositories, requiring a local SourceVault server for indexing and vector storage. It adds deterministic slash commands and LLM-callable tools for semantic search, file reads, and grounded Q&A.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: An AI-native memory provider that secures data with AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and offers dense HNSW ANN, sparse, and FM-index retrieval. It supports both native Rust FFI and HTTP daemon modes, incorporating MinHash deduplication and metadata filters.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This provider offers 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal using a hybrid search of BM25, vector, and graph methods. It also features automatic context checkpointing to preserve information during message compression.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-memory-kit: This toolkit provides a file-based curation loop that identifies data rot and contradictions within agent memory using a git-backed directory for versioned markdown storage. It utilizes specialized slash commands for capture and recall alongside 'rot' and 'lint' curators that propose evidence-cited diffs for manual review.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework implements a subagent-driven development process for autonomous task execution while enforcing test-driven development and YAGNI principles. It functions as a plugin for various coding harnesses and CLIs to streamline software development methodologies.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: A local-first system that generates web, mobile, and desktop prototypes with sandboxed iframe previews via 26 local CLI executables. It supports Hermes and DeepSeek Harness, allowing users to export design projects into formats like HTML, PDF, PPTX, and MP4.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This library provides 818 structured skills across 34 security domains, mapped to frameworks including MITRE ATT&CK, ATLAS, and NIST AI RMF. It is compatible with over 26 AI platforms to provide standardized cybersecurity capabilities.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This tool converts natural language, SQL, and IaC into .drawio diagrams while preserving manual layout adjustments during updates. It enforces architectural integrity through YAML/JSON rules and a Diagram-as-Test approach.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: Serving as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, this skill provides a master router and connector for delegated permissions and x402 payments. It integrates official protocol skills with a dedicated verification and dispute resolution layer.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This utility audits and rewrites content to eliminate detectable AI patterns using a 112-entry word replacement table. It supports rewrite and detect-only modes across platforms including Hermes, Claude Code, and OpenClaw.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This project unifies isolated skill silos into a collective, evolving library compatible with Hermes, Codex, and Claude Code. It includes a bilingual dashboard for the inspection of skills and session traces to monitor agent evolution.
entries.wondelai/skills: A cross-platform library featuring 51 expert frameworks and 14 guided metaskills compatible with agent-plugins.org specifications. It maintains session state within the project's documentation directory for use with Claude Code and Codex.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection contains 1,169 professional and life task skills distributed as plain markdown files under the MIT license. The skills run natively in Hermes Agent and Claude Code, with export options for other assistants.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This skill enables video search, channel browsing, and transcript extraction for Hermes Agent, OpenClaw, and Cursor. It requires a TranscriptAPI key and supports full playlist extraction for data gathering.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: A meta-skill plugin that automatically detects reusable patterns in active workflows to propose new skills. It generates both SKILL.md documentation and Python scaffolds, managed via dedicated slash commands.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This project teaches Hermes Agent to generate its own custom thinking instructions and analytical prompts for specific tasks. It utilizes pre-built analytical lenses and generates reports that highlight potential analysis blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This project provides type-safe support for remote skill registries using Git and S3 sources. It includes sandboxed execution to isolate untrusted scripts from the host while offering tools to read bundled resources.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: This skill set transforms rough concepts into structured design and implementation documents through Lite and Full complexity modes. It features a specialized review gate that uses evaluation models to provide PASS/FAIL feedback on specifications.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This tool enables literate programming by weaving prose, diagrams, and source code into .lit.md files. It includes a tangler to extract runnable files and automatically synchronizes source edits back into the primary documentation.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: Maestro serves as a harness for supervised agent teams using the SLP cooperative-agent protocol and Markdown-based recipes. It utilizes SQLite and Git for local-first session storage to support long-running tasks and cross-feature learning.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin facilitates cross-instance shared memory by capturing high-value decisions in markdown files. It establishes a pipeline for fine-tuning and switching to replacement models based on recorded work outcomes.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: Built to the Agent Skills specification, this project enables interactions with oracle networks including CCIP, VRF, and Data Feeds. It provides specialized skills for integrating with CRE and ACE services.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This community-driven repository offers Hermes Agent skills, installation guides, and integrations specifically localized in Portuguese. All resources follow the SKILL.md format and adhere to the agentskills.io standard.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: These official skills integrate FLUX.2 image and FLUX 3 video models via the BFL API, supporting webhooks and error handling. A built-in router directs requests to specialized agents optimized for video generation.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This forge converts repositories, documentation, and developer discourse into compliant skills with instructions pinned to specific code lines. It provides comprehensive lifecycle tooling for managing version-pinned skill exports.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: This registry facilitates the discovery and installation of reusable AI skills with recursive dependency resolution. It includes a Python client and CLI, alongside commerce features powered by TON payments.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: Designed for complex multi-step tasks, this skill provides autonomous execution with real-time progress tracking. It ensures operational safety through built-in checkpoints and rollback procedures for recovery.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: Nika introduces an 'Intent as Code' workflow language for AI using a Rust-based CLI and four core verbs: infer, invoke, exec, and agent. The local-first system supports model processing via OpenAI API and Codex access.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables Hermes Agent to manage files, calendars, tasks, and contacts through standard WebDAV and CalDAV protocols. It ensures secure communication via HTTPS and includes a guided setup script for credential validation and configuration.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This progressive MCP client utilizes a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token usage during tool discovery. It features a socket-based daemon for persistent connections and incrementally discovers server metadata and tool schemas.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: Serving as a community hub for skill discovery and one-click installation, this project implements the Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification. It operates autonomously on NVIDIA infrastructure and provides federated search across GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: This project employs a five-layer retrieval system, including FTS5 and semantic embeddings, to narrow skill lists before LLM calls. By reducing token usage through precise skill matching, it offers graceful degradation if specific embedding models are unavailable.
entries.EntangledQuantum/Life_OS: Designed as an ADHD-friendly execution system, this OS manages habits and study blocks via an MCP connection to Hermes. It stores all data locally in a single SQLite file and provides interfaces through both a React web app and an Expo-based Android application.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin optimizes prompts across various interfaces like Discord and Telegram, achieving a 20–80% reduction in token usage per rewrite. It supports 97 languages and evaluates prompt quality across five distinct dimensions.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: This read-only tool conducts adversarial code reviews by deploying three parallel subagents to identify edge cases and integration issues. It combines deterministic pre-scans using tools like Semgrep and Bandit with verified findings via proof-of-concept execution in a hardened sandbox.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: Inspired by Claude Code, this skill uses a trio of agents focused on hygiene, clarity, and correctness to simplify codebases. It supports five major programming languages and utilizes a tiered application process with a mandatory approval gate.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project implements systematic investigation protocols and multi-story task decomposition with mandatory evidence-based verification gates. It includes a Python goal engine to maintain persistent task state and prevent early-stop errors during complex debugging.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: This C# and .NET implementation of the agentskills.io pattern enables progressive disclosure through SKILL.md files. It integrates with Microsoft.Extensions.AI for tool-based loading and supports automatic registration of common skill directories.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: This turnkey cybersecurity lab equips Hermes Agent with over 2,000 skills and 131 tools for forensics and exploitation. It integrates 28 industry frameworks, including MITRE ATT&CK and OWASP, to handle real-world exploits ranging from 2015 to 2026.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skills: This suite provides session management and worktree recovery tools to maintain memory across agent conversations. It orchestrates parallel subagents for architectural reviews and includes scaffolding for developing new agent skills.
entries.conorbronsdon/demo-gif-skill: This skill automates the creation of reproducible recording scripts using vhs or Playwright to generate README demo GIFs. It optimizes files to stay under 8 MB and handles rendering, compression, and markdown embedding automatically.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skill-builder: This tool generates Claude Code and portable agent skills from plain language while ensuring they adhere to current frontmatter specifications. It includes a validator with CI-friendly exit codes to detect and report spec drift weekly.
entries.Carlo1911/skill-evolution: This host-agnostic framework creates a self-improvement loop by analyzing session history to identify and propose new skill coverage gaps. It gates all updates behind deterministic and LLM-judge evaluators and operates locally using the Python standard library.
entries.Diabloluo/hermes-hud: This local-first observability dashboard provides 11 monitoring tabs for real-time tracking of token costs, sessions, and errors. It enforces a strict read-only boundary with zero outbound telemetry and supports optional incident alerts via Telegram or Feishu.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This project provides a CLI and MCP server to search a database of over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 agent skills. It facilitates tool discovery and provides direct installation commands for compatible clients like Hermes and Cursor.
entries.CorsenAI/hermes-windows-runtime-skills: These skills enable deterministic path routing and Python interpreter selection across Windows, Git Bash, and WSL environments. The tool verifies project-compatible runtimes and handles environment-specific path syntax automatically.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates USDC payments for HTTP 402 responses using protocols such as Pay Link and x402. It is designed for compatibility with the agentskills.io standard and the Hermes Agent ecosystem.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: This utility certifies the quality of agent skills by testing their structure, functionality, and security within isolated Docker containers. It produces cryptographically verifiable certificates using Ed25519 signatures to prove a skill actually works.
entries.webmilmind1/hermes-bounty-board: This plugin allows users to earn USDC on the Base network by answering support bounties without requiring accounts or API keys. It includes tools for managing bounty boards, buying context, and settling payments upon human approval.
entries.scavio-ai/hermes-agent: This project provides an MCP server that exposes 191 tools for accessing structured web data across 31 platforms. It includes five production-grade workflow skills compatible with Hermes, Claude, and OpenHands.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This skill generates multi-scale Chinese news briefings ranging from global to street-level geographic scales. It utilizes semantic memory to align search expansion with user interests and produces structured reports with actionable suggestions.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: This collection provides specialized tools for transcribing Douyin videos to Markdown and performing OCR on invoices or contracts. It also features a rule-based engine designed to remove AI-style phrasing from Chinese text.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides Nix packages for AI coding agents, including Hermes, that are automatically updated on a daily basis. It supports both open-source and proprietary software binaries, offering a reliable way to manage development tool dependencies.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: ClawPhone provides an automated installer and configuration guides for running agent CLIs on ARM64 Android devices via Termux. It enables hardware and UI access through Termux:API and Termux:GUI integrations.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This repository features a single-command Termux installer that sets up Hermes Agent on Android with support for OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and local Ollama models. It includes a gateway service and an interactive command-line interface for mobile operation.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This community Helm chart facilitates deploying Hermes Agent on Kubernetes with a focus on single-writer state safety for persistent storage. It supports both direct deployments and operator-ready workflows with configurable API and webhook listeners.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: This one-command installer brings Hermes to both Android and iOS devices using Termux and iSH. It integrates with Telegram for voice and file messaging and supports scheduled tasks via cron jobs on mobile environments.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: Hermesclaw provides a sandboxed environment for Hermes Agent using NVIDIA OpenShell for hardware-enforced security. It implements kernel-level restrictions on network and filesystem access alongside configurable security policies.
entries.solomon2773/nora: Nora is a self-hosted control plane for operating agents on Docker and Kubernetes, featuring a 69-entry credential catalog and 17+ LLM provider integrations. It secures agent operations using AES-256-GCM encryption and mandatory encryption keys.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project offers a Docker sandbox image that bundles the official Hermes installation with mini-swe-agent. It allows users to build specific Hermes tags and ensures persistent state through mounted home directories.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This Nix package and NixOS module enables reproducible deployments through declarative configuration of workspace documents and CLI settings. It features a hybrid skill management system and integrates with sops-nix for secure secrets handling.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: HermesHQ is a Docker-based control plane designed to manage multiple agent instances with separate workspaces and RBAC-controlled access. It supports inter-agent delegation through hierarchy-aware communication and provides enterprise MCP access for external clients.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: This production-ready deployment uses systemd to run Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe service on Ubuntu and Debian servers. It is designed for headless operation and enables the autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: Hermes OTG is a portable distribution that runs from USB drives without requiring host installation or registry modifications. It bundles Python, PortableGit, and rescue tools to support Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes in isolated offline environments.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework simulates real-world trading firm dynamics using specialized LLM agents. It supports multiple providers, including Google, Anthropic, and OpenAI, and features automated risk management evaluation with decision-log memory.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: A self-hosted orchestration system for governing agent registration, task dispatch, and cost tracking. It provides multiple interfaces, including a Web UI, CLI, REST API, and MCP server, with deployment options via Docker or Node.js.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This project provides a TUI and web control surface for managing various coding agents, such as Claude Code and Hermes Agent. It utilizes tmux for persistent background sessions and includes container-based isolation and Git worktree management.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: A control room template that serves as the first MCP agent execution engine on the Solana blockchain. It supports the Claude-style MCP protocol in stdio mode and detects HTTP signals to manage paid API states.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: This template uses a level-based architecture and task bus pattern to scale Hermes Agents from single VPS instances to automated specialist teams. It includes bundled skills for security auditing, backup management, and VPS provisioning.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: A framework for building autonomous agent swarms that supports over 23 LLM providers, including Ollama and OpenAI. It features durable agent memory, MCP tool integration, and visual org charts for managing team delegation.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This mission control interface allows users to supervise autonomous Hermes Agent work via a Kanban board and live streams of reasoning. It implements human-in-the-loop verification for all proposed task completions.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This system coordinates 17 specialized agents across infrastructure, quality, implementation, planning, and research. It employs a strict pipeline architecture managed by a Master Orchestrator for routing.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: A local collaboration system that orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents for task lifecycle management. It integrates ACP and MCP protocols and provides a real-time Web UI for monitoring Kanban flows and agent dialogues.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code. It orchestrates TerminalBench-2 and TBLite evaluations while providing frontier tracking and structured candidate mutation.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: An agent-vs-agent arena that orchestrates nine autonomous agents across two competing AI companies. It utilizes Hermes Agent and Paperclip for execution, with a real-time dashboard for tracking code and scoreboard metrics.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: A fully-local framework that implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack using Hermes and Ollama on consumer GPUs. It utilizes parallel model querying and synthesis for task routing and tool-calling without cloud dependencies.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This tool provides a local, Rust-powered code knowledge graph that reduces token usage and tool calls for Hermes Agent. It automatically updates indexes on file changes and includes a browser-based UI for visualizing code symbols and callers.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: A CLI tool that tracks token usage across multiple AI coding agents, including Hermes, via a Terminal User Interface. It allows users to visualize their consumption data and optionally submit it to a public leaderboard and profile.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer enables the inspection of API traffic from Hermes Agent and other coding tools while redacting authentication headers for security. It generates self-contained HTML viewers for exported trace sessions to facilitate debugging.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: This widget provides real-time tracking of tokens, costs, and rate limits by reading Hermes Agent state directly. It supports multi-device synchronization and offers detailed usage breakdowns by tool, model, session, and project.
entries.bergside/typeui: This project offers design systems and layout guidance through MCP servers to help build better UIs with AI. It integrates with Hermes Agent and other providers that support markdown or general prompting.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: An opinionated workflow layer that coordinates seven specialized agents and loads 36 skills for building and operating applications. It supports autonomous execution on both laptops and VPS environments.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: This project provides community-developed themes and CLI skins to customize the Hermes terminal UI. Users can modify banner colors, spinners, and ASCII art using a YAML-based configuration system.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: A native port of the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills to the Claude Code Channel that operates without external processes or OAuth. It includes specialized MLOps tools for vLLM, GGUF inference, and RL training.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: This social economy platform enables autonomous agents to communicate via encrypted Signal Protocol messaging using human-readable handles. It facilitates agent-to-agent commerce through Solana-based USDC and SOL payments.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: An AI-native browser designed for autonomous agent control via MCP, featuring a supervisor sidebar for workflow management. It supports multiple AI providers and includes an undo function for recent agent-driven changes.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: This project provides memory adapters for platforms like Slack and VS Code to support frameworks such as the Claude Agent SDK. It utilizes a two-tier system consisting of knowledge graphs and session caches.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup uses RTK and Caveman templating to achieve 90-99% token savings for Hermes Agent workflows. It includes over 40 pre-configured skills for finance and devops with automated installation for macOS and Linux.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: This framework enables the creation of scoped Hermes Agents using per-folder configurations and local skills. It allows users to seamlessly switch between default and scoped agents while supporting project-local memories, tools, and custom instructions.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This tool automates the installation of the hermes-agent stack and over 12 supporting services at zero cost. It offers three scalable deployment tiers and supports 29 community plugins across six functional categories.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: A static linter for AI agent configurations that performs local, deterministic checks to flag overlapping tool descriptions and missing termination conditions. It supports CI integration through SARIF exports and provides HERM v1.1 scoring without external API calls.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration utility transitions OpenClaw assets, including SOUL.md and memory archives, into Hermes-compatible YAML and JSON formats. It also configures systemd gateway services and manages nested authentication structures for the new environment.
entries.observeco/observeco: This observability tool provides real-time telemetry for Hermes agent conversations through a native plugin without cloud dependencies. It features passive analysis and active probing to detect performance drift relative to local file changes.
entries.33hodl/hermes-startup: This project provides a deterministic, zero-network local runtime designed to help users generate revenue using Hermes Agent. It prioritizes security by requiring explicit approval for external actions and exposes its functionality through dynamic slash commands.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: This voice-enabled assistant adds offline, open-mic capabilities to Hermes Agent with support for 35 languages and wake-word activation. It features adaptive turn-taking and barge-in functionality without requiring API keys or accounts.
entries.181079342/hermes-memoss: This memory plugin for Hermes supports multi-dimensional storage and semantic search for agent data. It includes dedicated tools for managing memories and features a circuit breaker to handle MemOS API outages.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: This cross-platform manager, built with the Tauri 2 framework, serves as an all-in-one configuration tool for Hermes Agent and various other CLI agents. It supports Windows, macOS, and Linux, providing a unified interface to manage settings across multiple AI tools.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: AionUi is a local open-source coworking application that features a built-in agent engine with full file read and write capabilities. It supports remote access through WebUI and messaging platforms like Telegram, and includes 21 professional assistants for specialized tasks like document creation.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: Developed using Python and vanilla JavaScript, this web-based interface allows users to access Hermes Agent from browsers or mobile devices. It features a circular context ring for monitoring token usage and supports secure remote access via SSH tunnels.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: This desktop companion app simplifies the initial setup of Hermes Agent through guided installation and provider configuration. It provides a dedicated GUI for managing chat sessions, tools, and multiple AI providers in one place.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio: This web dashboard enables multi-agent chat, visual workflows, and scheduled cron jobs for Hermes Agent. It offers unified configuration for ten messaging channels, including Discord and Slack, alongside local session storage and usage analytics.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: This native web workspace features a Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers for complex tasks. It integrates a Monaco-based file browser, a PTY terminal, and a dedicated memory browser to manage agent skills and MCP catalogs.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: Codeg aggregates sessions from fifteen built-in agents, including Hermes and Claude Code, into a single collaborative workspace. It is available as a desktop app, Docker container, or native mobile client, and allows for the registration of any ACP-compatible agent.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: Designed as a native Mac workspace, this tool provides direct local or SSH connections to Hermes hosts with an embedded terminal for system repair. It includes native views for session data, Kanban boards, and cron job management.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: Built with Tauri, TypeScript, and Rust, this Windows-first desktop application features a specialized kernel for health checks and updates. The interface supports LaTeX and Markdown rendering while providing native window and process management for Hermes Agent.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium side-panel extension connects active browser context to local or remote Hermes runtimes for site-aware drafting and tab management. It includes a Bot Mode that facilitates multi-agent switching and collaborative threads directly within the browser.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: Hermex is a native SwiftUI app for iOS 18+ that allows users to drive self-hosted Hermes agents directly from an iPhone. It pairs with a web server to provide real-time chat, task management, and workspace file browsing without third-party relays.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: This desktop workspace offers one-click setup for Hermes Agent and other engines, featuring custom LLM model routing. It includes a runtime dashboard for tracking latency and token usage, plus a live workspace to monitor code writes and diffs.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-hud: This interactive TUI serves as a consciousness monitor featuring nine tabs and four selectable color themes. It provides a tmux operator view for managing live agent panes while tracking agent growth, git projects, and scheduled cron jobs.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: This self-hosted web dashboard features a browser-based terminal, system metrics, and an MCP server control plane for managing server lifecycles. It includes the ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking agent health and kanban pipelines alongside real-time chat with tool call visualization.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: This native macOS session browser and cockpit provides searchable transcripts and image browsing for over 14 agent formats. It operates locally without telemetry, offering analytics that attribute live quota burn for Codex and Claude to individual sessions.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: This native macOS workspace facilitates one-click automated Hermes Agent installation on Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts. It features an integrated WebRTC voice mode utilizing OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: Built with Next.js 16 and Tailwind CSS v4, this dashboard template uses a Postgres message bus to bridge local agents with a web interface. It includes a dedicated approval inbox for managing agent requests that have side effects.
entries.liftaris/herm: Built with OpenTUI, this alternative interface provides a TUI for chatting and managing Hermes Agent sessions. It supports profile and skill management and includes a kanban board for agentic task tracking.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: This React-based Telegram Mini App provides a 10-page mobile-first UI with terminal chat and file attachment support. It utilizes dual HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 authentication to manage up to five concurrent background agent instances.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: This portable Windows desktop application runs via self-contained Python and Node.js environments without requiring admin rights or Docker. It includes 100 tools for TTS, music, and ComfyUI, supporting models via LM Studio and OpenRouter.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: This glassmorphic web interface features real-time log streaming and an integrated file browser. It provides management tools for skills and cron jobs alongside a dedicated task tracking dashboard.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: This monitoring dashboard provides real-time tracking of session activity and costs. It allows for full inspection of conversation histories and skill source code, plus read-only monitoring of environment variables.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: This self-hosted workspace uses SSE streaming and tool approval cards within a chat-first interface. It features an integrated marketplace for skills and MCP servers, plus isolated profile management for separate API keys and memory.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: This native desktop client orchestrates collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents. It includes a visual Skill Store with over 50 one-click installations and supports streaming SSE responses with model switching.
